{"action":"shell","command":"cd /testbed && python3 - <<'PYEOF'
import os

checklist = """# Specification Quality Checklist: Smoke Add Utility

**Purpose**: Validate specification completeness and quality before proceeding to planning
**Created**: 2026-10-16
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

## Content Quality

- [x] No implementation details (languages, frameworks, APIs)
- [x] Focused on user value and business needs
- [x] Written for non-technical stakeholders
- [x] All mandatory sections completed

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] No [NEEDS CLARIFICATION] markers remain
- [x] Requirements are testable and unambiguous
- [x] Success criteria are measurable
- [x] Success criteria are technology-agnostic (no implementation details)
- [x] All acceptance scenarios are defined
- [x] Edge cases are identified
- [x] Scope is clearly bounded
- [x] Dependencies and assumptions identified

## Feature Readiness

- [x] All functional requirements have clear acceptance criteria
- [x] User scenarios cover primary flows
- [x] Feature meets measurable outcomes defined in Success Criteria
- [x] No implementation details leak into specification

## Notes

- All items pass on first validation iteration (2026-10-16).
- Module name `smoke.py` and function `add(a, b)` appear because the requirement text
  mandates them; they are stated requirements, not implementation choices.
- No [NEEDS CLARIFICATION] markers were needed: every unspecified detail had a
  reasonable default, recorded in the Assumptions section.
"""

with open('specs/001-transactions/checklists/requirements.md', 'w') as f:
    f.write(checklist)
print('checklist written:', os.path.getsize('specs/001-transactions/checklists/requirements.md'), 'bytes')

# validation scan
spec = open('specs/001-transactions/spec.md').read()
import re
print('NEEDS CLARIFICATION count:', spec.count('NEEDS CLARIFICATION'))
print('placeholder tokens:', re.findall(r'\[(?:FEATURE NAME|DATE|ARGUMENTS|###-feature-name)\]', spec))
for section in ['User Scenarios & Testing', 'Functional Requirements', 'Success Criteria', 'Assumptions', 'Edge Cases']:
    print('has section:', section, '->', section in spec)
PYEOF"}
